pages.title: Day and Night Range
pages.text: Daily range describes the temperature change between night and day. Reference values are:$(br)About 7°C near the equator$(br)About 9°C in the subtropics$(br)Close to 0°C near the poles.

pages.title: Rainfall Influence
pages.text: Current seasonal rainfall adjusts the day/night range. Dry areas generally vary more, while wet areas change more gently.$(br2)Daily range combines with annual range, elevation, coasts, and geology to produce the current temperature shown on the Climate tab. See $(l:the_world/climate#temperature)Calendar and Climate$().
